verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly publishes a pricing page that shows a $0/mo forever tier and states there is no per-seat pricing (unlimited seats, pricing based on usage). It also names some usage meters: AI Runs, which it defines, and monthly session replay and error allotments. However, the evidence does not show paid-tier prices or the exact usage metric and rates for core flag usage; a community comment says it charges by MAU, but this is not confirmed on the pricing page. missing for 10: published paid-tier price points, explicit MAU/service-connection/request unit rates and overage costs, independent corroboration of current cost drivers.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: $0/ mo, forever... Unlimited seats... Unlimited feature flags
No per-seat pricing. Invite your whole team; pricing is based on usage.
An AI Run is generated when you track an LLM request or run an online eval (LLM-as-a-judge).
